1115-2105-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1115-2105-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-2105-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

60-223.manaNeeded: {U/R}{U/R} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
60-223.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
60-223.description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Expansion by paying its mana cost.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Expansion and choosing to copy the original Expansion.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Expansion copy, creating a copy of Expansion.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.

2724-3217-7843.description:
Activate Elrond by paying {5}{U}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

864-1987-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
864-1987-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

6899-7637.description:
Any damage that would be dealt to you is redirected to Cho-Manno due to With Great Power . . ..
Because of Cho-Manno's effect, no damage will be dealt to it either, preventing the damage entirely.

2457-3129-4289-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

527-4885-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

339-677-6797-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

132-3525-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that share a creature type.
132-3525-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

2854-4211-4574-6900.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4211-4574-6900.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2921-5541-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1062-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
392-1062-5674-5870.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Harnfel ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-5086-6872.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Lord Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Repeat.
2034-5086-6872.notes: If mana allows, you can instead sacrifice the Triskelavites to their own abilities.

934-1399-1606-1671.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2034-2946-6462.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2034-2946-6462.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat

1537-3817-5231-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

2541-3022-5646.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2541-3022-5646.description:
Attempt to draw card, instead choosing to mill 3 cards and return Darkblast from your graveyard to your hand.
If you milled a nonland card, The Wise Mothman triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to draw a card and discard Darkblast.
Repeat.
2541-3022-5646.notes: The combo fails if you do not mill a nonland card.

803-1247-5832.notablePrerequisites:
Joraga Treespeaker has at least five level counters on it.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
803-1247-5832.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

372-3277-5530.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Another Round exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Izzet Chronarch exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Another Round.
372-3277-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Another Round.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2493-3617-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Archaeomancer each turn.
2493-3617-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying its mana cost.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Archaeomancer from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2316-4647-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4647-4871.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins.
When the Goblins die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Warrens ability, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

224-774-5478-5923.notablePrerequisites:
Wonderscape Sage does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one mana-producing land.
224-774-5478-5923.description:
Activate the mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Wonderscape Sage by tapping it and returning the mana-producing land from the battlefield to your hand, causing you to draw a card and discard a card if the land didn't have a nonbasic land type.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting the mana-producing land from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Wonderscape Sage.
Repeat.

1242-3386-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Nurturing Presence attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
1242-3386-4702.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Cinderhaze Wretch token enters the battlefield, the nontoken Cinderhaze Wretch triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1346-1817-2743.description:
Cast Repeated Reverberation by paying {2}{R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Repeated Reverberation triggers, copying Double Major twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Double Majors, creating three copies of the Biovisionary spells.
Resolve all Biovisionary spells, causing you to have a nontoken Biovisionary and three token Biovisionaries.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
